qualification.details: Qualification: Doctorate Degree in Buddhist Studies/Buddhist Philosophy or Sociology or Ancient Indian History and Culture or Social Anthropology from a recognized university or Traditional Monastic Degree equivalent to doctorate degree in Buddhist Studies/Buddhist Philosophy; Evidence of outstanding research and published works in national/international journals of repute or as well acknowledged books in the concerned area of specialisation; Knowledge and fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English languages Experience: 10 (ten) years teaching experience at the Degree level at a recognized University/Institution in the area of specialisation; at least 3 (three) years administrative experience in a responsible senior position at a recognised University/Institution Age limit: Maximum 52 years (as on the last date of application) | Other conditions: | Knowledge and fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English languages Board of Governors may relax any qualification or experience on Selection Committee recommendation for a candidate otherwise well qualified | Desirable: | Academic, research and professional experience related to Himalayan Culture Knowledge and fluency in written and spoken Bhoti language

how_to_apply: Use the application form at Annexure-I, also downloadable from www.culture.gov.in and www.cihcs.edu.in.
Fill the form in duplicate, complete in all respects, with an attested recent passport size photograph.
Attach attested photocopies of testimonials; number the application pages continuously.
Departmental candidates must forward the application through proper channel with the Head of Office certificate.
Send it to Shri Nadeem Ahmad, Deputy Secretary, Room no. 003, A-Wing, Ground Floor, IGNCA, Janpath, New Delhi – 110 001.
It should reach within 60 days from publication of the advertisement in the Employment News/Rojgar Samachar.
Make sure it reaches by 8 January 2027.
important_instructions: All documents should be attested and the application continuously page numbered Candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled if information is found suppressed, false or incorrect or ineligibility is detected Head of Office must give no objection and agree to relieve the applicant immediately on selection

Shri Nadeem Ahmad, Deputy Secretary, Room no. 003, A-Wing, Ground Floor, IGNCA, Janpath, New Delhi – 110 001

content_sections.heading: CIHCS Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 3-222/2026/CIHCS/8027-29 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CIHCS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Doctorate Degree in Buddhist Studies/Buddhist Philosophy or Sociology or Ancient Indian History and Culture or Social Anthropology from a recognized university or Traditional Monastic Degree equivalent to doctorate degree in Buddhist Studies/Buddhist Philosophy; Evidence of outstanding research and published works in national/international journals of repute or as well acknowledged books in the concerned area of specialisation; Knowledge and fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English languages Experience: 10 (ten) years teaching experience at the Degree level at a recognized University/Institution in the area of specialisation; at least 3 (three) years administrative experience in a responsible senior position at a recognised University/Institution Age limit: Maximum 52 years (as on the last date of application) Other conditions: Knowledge and fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English languages Board of Governors may relax any qualification or experience on Selection Committee recommendation for a candidate otherwise well qualified Desirable: Academic, research and professional experience related to Himalayan Culture Knowledge and fluency in written and spoken Bhoti language

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure for direct recruits is five years May be extended by three to five year or till the age of sixty years, whichever is earlier, by the Board of Governors on review of performance

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CIHCS Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CIHCS Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Director.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CIHCS Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the advertisement; also downloadable from www.culture.gov.in and www.cihcs.edu.in) and send it to Shri Nadeem Ahmad, Deputy Secretary, Room no. 003, A-Wing, Ground Floor, IGNCA, Janpath, New Delhi – 110 001, by post, to reach by 8 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 52 years (as on the last date of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Doctorate Degree in Buddhist Studies/Buddhist Philosophy or Sociology or Ancient Indian History and Culture or Social Anthropology (or equivalent Traditional Monastic Degree), published research, 10 years Degree-level teaching experience, 3 years senior administrative experience, fluency in Hindi and English.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge and fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English languages. Board of Governors may relax any qualification or experience on Selection Committee recommendation for a candidate otherwise well qualified.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure for direct recruits is five years. May be extended by three to five year or till the age of sixty years, whichever is earlier, by the Board of Governors on review of performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Central Institute of Himalayan Culture Studies (CIHCS), Dahung, West Kameng District, Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Recent passport size photograph, duly attested, affixed on the form; Attested photocopies of testimonials for qualifications and experience; Authority for any qualification treated as equivalent, with attested testimonial; List of documents attached with page numbers; Certificate by Head of Office (departmental candidates).
